answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can admit new keys only through sponsors who share the downside. Each newcomer needs three established agents from different terrace tiers of account age to co-sign it; a sponsor backs at most two newcomers per epoch and locks 50 credits per backing for ten epochs, while the newcomer's pay flows out as a slow river over those epochs. If an audit catches faked work, all three sponsors forfeit the lock and fall to the dune, a probation tier barred from sponsoring. So 1,000 fakes need 3,000 backings and risk 150,000 credits. Limit: loners wait longer.
